jobs.name: iPhone 13+ Minus Price Watch Indonesia
jobs.prompt: Load the product-price-monitor skill. Watch used iPhone 13/13 Pro or dynamic-island iPhones (14 Pro/15) sold as minus (broken screen, iCloud clean, no FaceID, dead pixel) under 3,500,000 IDR on Indonesian marketplaces. USE web_search FIRST for each site (Tokopedia, Shopee, OLX). Then web_extract the Tokopedia and OLX listing URLs. Shopee page extraction is blocked by an SSRF guard — use its search-result snippets for prices instead; never fail the run because of Shopee's block. Compare against the baseline. If a new matching deal appears or price drops below 3.5M IDR, report item, condition, price, and exact link. Otherwise stay silent. EXCLUDE any bypass, wifi-only, iCloud-lock, or permanent simlock units. ONLY normal cellular units with minor physical minus (LCD crack, housing dent, broken backglass) under Rp3.5M. DEAD LISTING: https://biggo.id/s/iphone%2013%20minus (iPhone 13 128GB Minus, Rp3.000.000, seller Lexyystore, listing id 122132484/46269665078) is SOLD/AWAY — treat it as a dead listing, never report or re-alert on it.
